fullText.simplified:
四、没有更好的办法

    将军在等花家的人出来，接令牌。接了令牌的人，三天后要带好令牌去军队。
    将军说：“花家人呢？快一点儿！”
    花木兰的爸爸走了出来。他今年已经五十多岁了，二十年前他参过军，在战场上，他的一条腿受伤了。现在他走路很难，所以他走得很慢。
    他一步一步走向将军。大家都看着他，将军在等着他，这让他有点儿着急。他想走快点儿，但是这让他差点儿摔在地上。木兰担心极了，她真想跑上去帮爸爸。
    将军看了看木兰的爸爸，说：“你的腿受伤了？你有儿子吗？可以让你的儿子参军。”
    “我的儿子还小，他今年只有十岁。”木兰的爸爸回答道。
    “但是你……”将军看着眼前的老人，有些担心。
    “我可以的，将军。”木兰爸爸认真地说道。
    是啊，也没更好的办法了。国家要求，每家必须有一个男人参军，花家也必须这样做。想到这里，将军把令牌放到了木兰爸爸的手上。
    晚上，木兰一家在一起吃饭。
    妈妈没说话，她一直给丈夫加着饭菜。
    爸爸先说话了：“你们别担心，我以前也参过军，我可以的。”
    “那时候你二十多岁，现在你五十多岁，这怎么能一样？还有你的腿，怎么去战场？如果这次你去了，还能平安回来吗？”妈妈又着急又难过。
    “我会回来的，你相信我。”爸爸说道。
    爸爸想了想，又说：“我走了以后，你还要带两个孩子。木兰你长大了，你有时间多帮帮妈妈，弟弟还小，也需要你的照顾。”
    爸爸看向妈妈和木兰，他还有很多话想跟她们说。
fullText.traditional:
四、沒有更好的辦法

    將軍在等花家的人出來，接令牌。接了令牌的人，三天後要帶好令牌去軍隊。
    將軍說：“花家人呢？快一點兒！”
    花木蘭的爸爸走了出來。他今年已經五十多歲了，二十年前他參過軍，在戰場上，他的一條腿受傷了。現在他走路很難，所以他走得很慢。
    他一步一步走向將軍。大家都看著他，將軍在等著他，這讓他有點兒著急。他想走快點兒，但是這讓他差點兒摔在地上。木蘭擔心極了，她真想跑上去幫爸爸。
    將軍看了看木蘭的爸爸，說：“你的腿受傷了？你有兒子嗎？可以讓你的兒子參軍。”
    “我的兒子還小，他今年只有十歲。”木蘭的爸爸回答道。
    “但是你……”將軍看著眼前的老人，有些擔心。
    “我可以的，將軍。”木蘭爸爸認真地說道。
    是啊，也沒更好的辦法了。國家要求，每家必須有一個男人參軍，花家也必須這樣做。想到這裡，將軍把令牌放到了木蘭爸爸的手上。
    晚上，木蘭一家在一起吃飯。
    媽媽沒說話，她一直給丈夫加著飯菜。
    爸爸先說話了：“你們別擔心，我以前也參過軍，我可以的。”
    “那時候你二十多歲，現在你五十多歲，這怎麼能一樣？還有你的腿，怎麼去戰場？如果這次你去了，還能平安回來嗎？”媽媽又著急又難過。
    “我會回來的，你相信我。”爸爸說道。
    爸爸想了想，又說：“我走了以後，你還要帶兩個孩子。木蘭你長大了，你有時間多幫幫媽媽，弟弟還小，也需要你的照顧。”
    爸爸看向媽媽和木蘭，他還有很多話想跟她們說。

sentences.traditional: 將軍在等花家的人出來，接令牌。
sentences.pinyin: jiāng jūn zài děng huā jiā de rén chū lái jiē lìng pái
sentences.english: The general was waiting for someone from the Hua family to come forward to receive the token of authority.

sentences.simplified: 接了令牌的人，三天后要带好令牌去军队。
sentences.traditional: 接了令牌的人，三天後要帶好令牌去軍隊。
sentences.pinyin: jiē le lìng pái de rén sān tiān hòu yào dài hǎo lìng pái qù jūn duì
sentences.english: The person who received the token of authority must take it to the army in three days’ time.

sentences.simplified: 将军说：“花家人呢？快一点儿！”
sentences.traditional: 將軍說：“花家人呢？快一點兒！”
sentences.pinyin: jiāng jūn shuō huā jiā rén ne kuài yì diǎn'r
sentences.english: The general said, “Where are the people from the Hua family? Hurry up!”

sentences.simplified: 花木兰的爸爸走了出来。
sentences.traditional: 花木蘭的爸爸走了出來。
sentences.pinyin: huā mù lán de bà ba zǒu le chu lai
sentences.english: Hua Mulan’s father stepped forward.

sentences.simplified: 他今年已经五十多岁了，二十年前他参过军，在战场上，他的一条腿受伤了。
sentences.traditional: 他今年已經五十多歲了，二十年前他參過軍，在戰場上，他的一條腿受傷了。
sentences.pinyin: tā jīn nián yǐ jīng wǔ shí duō suì le èr shí nián qián tā cān guò jūn zài zhàn chǎng shang tā de yì tiáo tuǐ shòu shāng le
sentences.english: He was already over fifty years old. He had served in the army twenty years earlier, and one of his legs was injured on the battlefield.

sentences.simplified: 现在他走路很难，所以他走得很慢。
sentences.traditional: 現在他走路很難，所以他走得很慢。
sentences.pinyin: xiàn zài tā zǒu lù hěn nán suǒ yǐ tā zǒu de hěn màn
sentences.english: Now, it was hard for him to walk, so he walked very slowly.

sentences.simplified: 他一步一步走向将军。
sentences.traditional: 他一步一步走向將軍。
sentences.pinyin: tā yí bù yí bù zǒu xiàng jiāng jūn
sentences.english: He walked step by step toward the general.

sentences.simplified: 大家都看着他，将军在等着他，这让他有点儿着急。
sentences.traditional: 大家都看著他，將軍在等著他，這讓他有點兒著急。
sentences.pinyin: dà jiā dōu kàn zhe tā jiāng jūn zài děng zhe tā zhè ràng tā yǒu diǎn'r zháo jí
sentences.english: Everyone was watching him, and the general was waiting for him, which made him quite anxious.

sentences.simplified: 他想走快点儿，但是这让他差点儿摔在地上。
sentences.traditional: 他想走快點兒，但是這讓他差點兒摔在地上。
sentences.pinyin: tā xiǎng zǒu kuài diǎn'r dàn shì zhè ràng tā chà diǎn'r shuāi zài dì shang
sentences.english: He wanted to walk faster, but this almost made him fall to the ground.

sentences.simplified: 木兰担心极了，她真想跑上去帮爸爸。
sentences.traditional: 木蘭擔心極了，她真想跑上去幫爸爸。
sentences.pinyin: mù lán dān xīn jí le tā zhēn xiǎng pǎo shàng qù bāng bà ba
sentences.english: Mulan was extremely worried. She really wanted to run up there and help her father.

sentences.simplified: 将军看了看木兰的爸爸，说：“你的腿受伤了？你有儿子吗？可以让你的儿子参军。”
sentences.traditional: 將軍看了看木蘭的爸爸，說：“你的腿受傷了？你有兒子嗎？可以讓你的兒子參軍。”
sentences.pinyin: jiāng jūn kàn le kàn mù lán de bà ba shuō nǐ de tuǐ shòu shāng le nǐ yǒu ér zi ma kě yǐ ràng nǐ de ér zi cān jūn
sentences.english: The general looked at Mulan’s father and said, “Your leg is injured? Do you have a son? You can have your son join the army.”

sentences.simplified: “我的儿子还小，他今年只有十岁。”木兰的爸爸回答道。
sentences.traditional: “我的兒子還小，他今年只有十歲。”木蘭的爸爸回答道。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ de ér zi hái xiǎo tā jīn nián zhǐ yǒu shí suì mù lán de bà ba huí dá dào
sentences.english: “My son is still young. He is only ten years old,” Mulan’s father replied.

sentences.simplified: “但是你……”将军看着眼前的老人，有些担心。
sentences.traditional: “但是你……”將軍看著眼前的老人，有些擔心。
sentences.pinyin: dàn shì nǐ jiāng jūn kàn zhe yǎn qián de lǎo rén yǒu xiē dān xīn
sentences.english: “But you …” The general looked at the old man in front of him, somewhat concerned.

sentences.simplified: “我可以的，将军。”木兰爸爸认真地说道。
sentences.traditional: “我可以的，將軍。”木蘭爸爸認真地說道。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ kě yǐ de jiāng jūn mù lán bà ba rèn zhēn de shuō dào
sentences.english: “I can do it, General,” Mulan’s father said earnestly.

sentences.simplified: 是啊，也没更好的办法了。
sentences.traditional: 是啊，也沒更好的辦法了。
sentences.pinyin: shì a yě méi gèng hǎo de bàn fǎ le
sentences.english: Yes, there is no better way.

sentences.simplified: 国家要求，每家必须有一个男人参军，花家也必须这样做。
sentences.traditional: 國家要求，每家必須有一個男人參軍，花家也必須這樣做。
sentences.pinyin: guó jiā yāo qiú měi jiā bì xū yǒu yí ge nán rén cān jūn huā jiā yě bì xū zhè yàng zuò
sentences.english: The country demands that each family must send one man to join the army, and the Hua family must do the same.

sentences.simplified: 想到这里，将军把令牌放到了木兰爸爸的手上。
sentences.traditional: 想到這裡，將軍把令牌放到了木蘭爸爸的手上。
sentences.pinyin: xiǎng dào zhè lǐ jiāng jūn bǎ lìng pái fàng dào le mù lán bà ba de shǒu shang
sentences.english: Thinking of this, the general placed the token of authority in Mulan’s father’s hand.

sentences.simplified: 晚上，木兰一家在一起吃饭。
sentences.traditional: 晚上，木蘭一家在一起吃飯。
sentences.pinyin: wǎn shang mù lán yì jiā zài yì qǐ chī fàn
sentences.english: In the evening, Mulan’s family ate dinner together.

sentences.simplified: 妈妈没说话，她一直给丈夫加着饭菜。
sentences.traditional: 媽媽沒說話，她一直給丈夫加著飯菜。
sentences.pinyin: mā ma méi shuō huà tā yì zhí gěi zhàng fu jiā zhe fàn cài
sentences.english: Her mother didn’t speak. She kept adding food to her husband’s plate.

sentences.simplified: 爸爸先说话了：“你们别担心，我以前也参过军，我可以的。”
sentences.traditional: 爸爸先說話了：“你們別擔心，我以前也參過軍，我可以的。”
sentences.pinyin: bà ba xiān shuō huà le nǐ men bié dān xīn wǒ yǐ qián yě cān guò jūn wǒ kě yǐ de
sentences.english: Her father spoke first, “Don’t worry, everyone. I have served in the army before. I can do it.”

sentences.simplified: “那时候你二十多岁，现在你五十多岁，这怎么能一样？
sentences.traditional: “那時候你二十多歲，現在你五十多歲，這怎麼能一樣？
sentences.pinyin: nà shí hou nǐ èr shí duō suì xiàn zài nǐ wǔ shí duō suì zhè zěn me néng yí yàng
sentences.english: “Back then, you were in your twenties, and now you are in your fifties. How can it be the same?

sentences.simplified: 还有你的腿，怎么去战场？如果这次你去了，还能平安回来吗？”
sentences.traditional: 還有你的腿，怎麼去戰場？如果這次你去了，還能平安回來嗎？”
sentences.pinyin: hái yǒu nǐ de tuǐ zěn me qù zhàn chǎng rú guǒ zhè cì nǐ qù le hái néng píng ān huí lái ma
sentences.english: And your leg, how will you go into the battlefield? If you go this time, will you be able to come back safely?”

sentences.simplified: 妈妈又着急又难过。
sentences.traditional: 媽媽又著急又難過。
sentences.pinyin: mā ma yòu zháo jí yòu nán guò
sentences.english: Mulan’s mother was both anxious and sad.

sentences.simplified: “我会回来的，你相信我。”爸爸说道。
sentences.traditional: “我會回來的，你相信我。”爸爸說道。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ huì huí lái de nǐ xiāng xìn wǒ bà ba shuō dào
sentences.english: “I will come back, trust me,” her father said.

sentences.simplified: 爸爸想了想，又说：“我走了以后，你还要带两个孩子。
sentences.traditional: 爸爸想了想，又說：“我走了以後，你還要帶兩個孩子。
sentences.pinyin: bà ba xiǎng le xiǎng yòu shuō wǒ zǒu le yǐ hòu nǐ hái yào dài liǎng ge hái zi
sentences.english: Her father thought for a moment and then said, “After I’m gone, you’ll still have to take care of the two children.

sentences.simplified: 木兰你长大了，你有时间多帮帮妈妈，
sentences.traditional: 木蘭你長大了，你有時間多幫幫媽媽，
sentences.pinyin: mù lán nǐ zhǎng dà le nǐ yǒu shí jiān duō bāng bāng mā ma
sentences.english: Mulan, you have grown up. Please help your mother more when you have time.

sentences.simplified: 弟弟还小，也需要你的照顾。”
sentences.traditional: 弟弟還小，也需要你的照顧。”
sentences.pinyin: dì di hái xiǎo yě xū yào nǐ de zhào gù
sentences.english: Your younger brother is still small and needs your care as well.”

sentences.simplified: 爸爸看向妈妈和木兰，他还有很多话想跟她们说。
sentences.traditional: 爸爸看向媽媽和木蘭，他還有很多話想跟她們說。
sentences.pinyin: bà ba kàn xiàng mā ma hé mù lán tā hái yǒu hěn duō huà xiǎng gēn tā men shuō
sentences.english: Mulan’s father looked at Mulan and her mother. He still had a lot to say to them.

sentence_translations: (4) There Is No Better Way
The general was waiting for someone from the Hua family to come forward to receive the token of authority.
The person who received the token of authority must take it to the army in three days’ time.
The general said, “Where are the people from the Hua family? Hurry up!”
Hua Mulan’s father stepped forward.
He was already over fifty years old. He had served in the army twenty years earlier, and one of his legs was injured on the battlefield.
Now, it was hard for him to walk, so he walked very slowly.
He walked step by step toward the general.
Everyone was watching him, and the general was waiting for him, which made him quite anxious.
He wanted to walk faster, but this almost made him fall to the ground.
Mulan was extremely worried. She really wanted to run up there and help her father.
The general looked at Mulan’s father and said, “Your leg is injured? Do you have a son? You can have your son join the army.”
“My son is still young. He is only ten years old,” Mulan’s father replied.
“But you …” The general looked at the old man in front of him, somewhat concerned.
“I can do it, General,” Mulan’s father said earnestly.
Yes, there is no better way.
The country demands that each family must send one man to join the army, and the Hua family must do the same.
Thinking of this, the general placed the token of authority in Mulan’s father’s hand.
In the evening, Mulan’s family ate dinner together.
Her mother didn’t speak. She kept adding food to her husband’s plate.
Her father spoke first, “Don’t worry, everyone. I have served in the army before. I can do it.”
“Back then, you were in your twenties, and now you are in your fifties. How can it be the same?
And your leg, how will you go into the battlefield? If you go this time, will you be able to come back safely?”
Mulan’s mother was both anxious and sad.
“I will come back, trust me,” her father said.
Her father thought for a moment and then said, “After I’m gone, you’ll still have to take care of the two children.
Mulan, you have grown up. Please help your mother more when you have time.
Your younger brother is still small and needs your care as well.”
Mulan’s father looked at Mulan and her mother. He still had a lot to say to them.
